quarterly_data.signal: NEC joined Project Glasswing, an Anthropic-led initiative to secure critical software, and is using Anthropic's frontier AI model 'Claude Mythos Preview' for defensive cybersecurity work: under its 'Client Zero' initiative it will use Mythos in its own software development, system operations and vulnerability management processes, and apply the insights to the design, governance and expertise of its security services. Background stated by NEC: in April 2026 it became the first Japanese company (its claim) to enter into a global partnership with Anthropic, and since then the companies have been jointly developing industry-specific, task-oriented AI solutions and integrating Claude into NEC BluStellar Scenario.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: AI model supplier and global partner
